手动「下载到本地」和对端「推送」接收都默认存这里（选了「每次选择位置」时，接收需: “Download to this device” and incoming pushes both land here by default. With “Choose a location each time”, a push that needs your confirmation first asks you to pick a folder, and that folder becomes the root for this transfer. Pushes go into a folder named after the sender by default (turn that off with the switch below) and unfold into the name of each selected item, so they never mix with your downloaded files.
打开（默认）：对端推来的东西落在 发送方名 那一层下面 —— 下载目录\\某某的: On (default): pushed items land under a folder named after the sender — Download folder\Alice's PC\… . Three things follow: two devices pushing a file with the same name don't overwrite each other; a batch can be reviewed and cleared as a whole per source; and when receiving a push that needs your confirmation, the folder grant only lets it create its own folder inside the root, never touching anything already there.
关掉：推送和手动下载的文件落在同一层。同名的照旧自动改名 xxx (1).ext: Off: pushed files and manual downloads land on the same level. Same names are still renamed automatically to xxx (1).ext; the cost is that a pushed D\… merges into the D folder you already have in the download folder (for paired devices, a push with the same name is atomically replaced after verification), and the folder you pick under “Choose a location each time” lets the other side write filenames straight into that level.

被占用时自动 +1 探测，实际端口显示在底部状态栏。: Probes +1 when the port is taken; the actual port shows in the status bar.
一次接收同时跑几路传输（一块 / 一个文件算一路）。局域网上 4 就够把千兆喂饱: How many transfers run at once when receiving (one block or one file counts as one). On a LAN, 4 is enough to saturate gigabit; going above 8 only piles up connections, handles and disk queues and slows everything down. Range 1–8; out-of-range values are clamped on save.
大文件按它切片、片与片之间并行。4MB 在千兆下约 33ms 一块 —— 取消: Large files are split into blocks of this size and the blocks run in parallel. On gigabit, 4MB is about 33ms per block — that is the scale of the delay you feel when cancelling or failing, while the cost of resending one block stays low. Range 1–32; out-of-range values are clamped on save. Larger than that is no longer parallel — it is half a file per transfer.
收起后常驻屏幕上的那件东西长什么样。缩略图就是实物外观（角标、分页点都在），里面: What the thing that stays on screen after collapsing looks like. The thumbnails show the real appearance (badges and page dots included); the device names, addresses and badge numbers inside are sample data.

LocalSend 设备不配对、不进聊天群，设备列表里只用于一对一传文件；收到的: LocalSend devices are never paired and never join chat groups — in the device list they are only for one-to-one file transfers. Incoming items land on disk only after you confirm, and text messages appear in notifications only.

① 替其它设备盲转字节：两台设备在同一张 Wi-Fi 上互相连不上时（有些 AP: ① Relay raw bytes for other devices: when two devices on the same Wi-Fi cannot reach each other (some access points isolate clients), this device — connected to both A and B — carries bytes for them. Direct connections are still preferred; data stays end-to-end encrypted and this device only moves bytes without seeing them. Unpaired devices are not excluded: while this is on, any device in the same subnet that can reach this one may borrow it (the one mandatory check left is verifying the target's identity against the address the peer supplied — without it this device would become a tunnel to any LAN address).
② 替群聊中转消息：群里两个成员互相够不着时（跨网段、只有本机跟它们都连得上），: ② Relay messages for a group chat: when two members cannot reach each other (across subnets, with only this device connected to both), this device forwards a copy of their messages, up to 3 hops, and never forwards the same message twice (no loops).
默认打开：两条路都占本机上行带宽 —— 这笔开销该不该出由你定，首次启动就是开的: On by default: both paths consume this device's upload bandwidth, so whether to pay that cost is your call. It starts out on; turn it off if you would rather not. When peers can connect directly, this switch makes no difference. Turning it off immediately tears down every relay this device is currently running.
本机替够不着彼此的其它设备搬字节、替够不着的同群成员转消息；会占用本机上行带宽: Carry bytes for other devices that cannot reach each other and forward messages for unreachable group members; uses this device's upload bandwidth
本机替别人中转累计搬过的数据量（收发两个方向之和）与连接数 —— 中转方的代价就: How much data this device has carried for others in total (both directions combined) and how many connections — the price of relaying is upload bandwidth, and this is the bill.
只统计本机当中转方替别人搬的那部分：替其它设备盲转的字节，以及替群聊转发出去的消: Only what this device relayed as the middleman counts: raw bytes carried for other devices and messages forwarded for group chats. Messages this device sends itself that travel through someone else's relay are not included.
The connection count only covers raw-relay connections (message relaying does not count as a connection). It is persisted (`relayBytesTotal` / `relayConnsTotal` in `config.toml`) and keeps accumulating across restarts.
还没有替别人中转 —— 有设备借本机中转之后才会有: Nothing relayed yet — this fills in once a device relays through this one
装之前会校验 sha256 与开发者签名：签名对不上的一律拒装（发布仓被换包也装: Before installing, the sha256 and the developer signature are verified: anything whose signature does not match is refused (a swapped package in a release repo cannot be installed either).
桌面端是单文件 exe：更新时用新版本覆盖当前这个文件并自动重启，更新完依旧只有: The desktop build is a single exe: updating overwrites this very file with the new version and restarts automatically, so there is still exactly one exe afterwards (settings, logs and transfer history live in the data directory and are unaffected).
安卓端下的是 APK，装的时候系统会弹一次确认 —— 非系统应用不能静默安装。: Android downloads an APK, and the system asks for confirmation once when installing — non-system apps cannot install silently.
全部设备的 token 存在本机数据目录的一个文件里（仅遮挡、非加密）。这里是唯: Tokens for all devices live in one file in this device's data directory (obscured, not encrypted). This is the only place to delete them: clearing sends every device back to “Not paired” and they must pair again; WebDAV profiles already written into Beyond Compare are removed as well.

LocalSend 设备不配对、不进聊天群，只走一对一；文本和图片始终自动接收并: LocalSend devices are never paired and never join chat groups — only one-to-one conversations. Text and images are always accepted automatically and shown in the conversation; ordinary files still need your confirmation.
开启后立即生效，不等「保存设置」。53317 被占用时先回落主端口，端口空出后自: Takes effect immediately, without waiting for “Save settings”. If 53317 is taken, it falls back to the main port and takes 53317 back automatically once it is free; it will not turn itself off.
已开启；本机离线时自动暂停，上线后恢复。: On. Paused while this device is offline; it resumes when you go online.
